mutations.name: W4-M1: ignore the explicit supports_images=false bit
W4-M2: read silence as 'no images' and strip unknown models
W4-M3: strip the images silently without counting them
W4-M4: strip the images without the operator warn
mutations.anchor: log.warn(`Chat[${reqId}]: DEVIN_CONNECT selector ${safeLogValue(selector)} declares supports_images=false in the live catalog — dropped ${stripped.dropped} image block(s) before the wire; text preserved (counted in images_dropped_capability)`);

mutations.name: W4-M5: drop the whole content array instead of only image blocks
W4-M6: count messages instead of image blocks
W4-M7: leave tool-result images on the wire
mutations.anchor:
if (!msg || msg.role === 'system' || !Array.isArray(msg.content)) continue;
    const kept = msg.content.filter((block) => !isWireImageBlock(block));
mutations.replacement:
if (!msg || msg.role === 'system' || msg.role === 'tool' || !Array.isArray(msg.content)) continue;
    const kept = msg.content.filter((block) => !isWireImageBlock(block));

mutations.name: W4-M8: lose the capability lookup (always unknown)
